name: the marking provisional and contested: success judged and credit disputed while the work goes on
what_it_changes: P11 says that when a work is up the room marks it: announces, celebrates and credits. In these rooms marking comes while the work is still live and is open to dispute: success is judged by what survives, completion is provisional, upkeep goes on, and credit is challenged and corrected.
why: Cut rules R1 and R2 (tree-D4.md), with R1a (the level): the key's lines, read whole in _analysis/d4a02_keys/add-step_P11_T4-026.txt, state one shared change to P11. R1a: T3-009 (celebrating the finished work) holds 15 of the 36 rooms and T3-043 (crediting who made the work) 14, so the branch is declared at the fourth order. 'Completion can be provisional and answered by an instruction to keep working' (fxKorea); 'Participants contest authorship during active work' (afip). These are the labelers' how sentences.
